verdict.rationale: The Dashboard shows total controls, controls with owners, and flags controls needing attention. The Compliance Roadmap can filter Unified Controls by framework and group them by Status, and a framework-controls view sits alongside Unified Controls, so an operations lead can piece together passing versus open controls per framework. The Monitors page also surfaces violations as part of managing audit readiness. Missing for 10: any documented per-framework readiness percentage or single progress score, an explicit 'what's left to be audit-ready' summary, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how honest or accurate the readiness view is.
